text_en: Not to us, O Lord , not to us, but to your name give glory, for the sake of your steadfast love and your faithfulness.
text_cn: 上主，光荣不要归于我们，不要归于我们！ 只愿那个光荣完全归于你的圣名， 那是为了你的慈爱，为了你的忠诚。

text_en: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God? ”
text_cn: 为什么让外邦人们常说： 他们的天主在何处居住？

text_en: Our God is in the heavens; he does whatever he pleases.
text_cn: 我们的天主在天上居住， 他创造了所喜爱的万物。

text_en: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of human hands.
text_cn: 外邦人的偶像无非金银， 不过是人手中的制造品：

text_en: They have mouths, but do not speak; eyes, but do not see.
text_cn: 偶像有口，而不能言， 偶像有眼，而不能看，

text_en: They have ears, but do not hear; noses, but do not smell.
text_cn: 有耳，而不能听， 有鼻，而不能闻，

text_en: They have hands, but do not feel; feet, but do not walk; they make no sound in their throats.
text_cn: 有手，而不能动， 有脚，而不能行， 有喉，而不发声。

text_en: Those who make them are like them; so are all who trust in them.
text_cn: 铸造偶像的人，将与偶像同亡； 凡信赖偶像的人，也将是一样。

text_en: O Israel, trust in the Lord ! He is their help and their shield.
text_cn: 以色列家族却信赖上主， 他是他们的助佑和盾护；

text_en: O house of Aaron, trust in the Lord ! He is their help and their shield.
text_cn: 亚郎的家族也信赖上主， 他是他们的助佑和盾护；

text_en: You who fear the Lord , trust in the Lord ! He is their help and their shield.
text_cn: 敬畏上主的人信赖上主， 他是他们的助佑和盾护。

text_en: The Lord has been mindful of us; he will bless us; he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron;
text_cn: 上主眷念我们，也必给我们祝福， 祝福以色列家族，祝福亚郎家族；

text_en: he will bless those who fear the Lord , both small and great.
text_cn: 他向敬畏上主的人祝福， 不拘贵贱都要获得祝福，

text_en: May the Lord give you increase, both you and your children.
text_cn: 愿上主使你们的人口繁昌， 使你们和你们的子孙兴旺！

text_en: May you be blessed by the Lord , who made heaven and earth.
text_cn: 愿你们蒙受上主的祝福， 他是上天下地的造化主！

text_en: The heavens are the Lord ’s heavens, but the earth he has given to human beings.
text_cn: 苍天确实是上主的苍天， 上主给世人赏赐了尘寰。

text_en: The dead do not praise the Lord , nor do any that go down into silence.
text_cn: 死人们不能够赞美上主， 降入阴府的人也不能够，

text_en: But we will bless the Lord from this time on and forevermore. Praise the Lord !
text_cn: 而是我们赞颂上主， 从现今一直到永久。
